items.title: Cybersecurity aur mehfooz digital ishtirak: ta'aruf (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: chapter 9 Introduction and Figure 9.1 (PDF 122), paragraph for paragraph; the cybersecurity definition from the Summary is a Roman Urdu box only.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein talaba dekhenge ke technology digital duniya mein mehfooz (safe), secure aur zimmedarana shirkat (participation) mein kaise madad karti hai. Woh online safety, cybersecurity, data protection (data ki hifazat), privacy settings aur jadeed digital platforms par mehfooz collaboration (mil kar kaam) ke bare mein seekhenge. Chapter digital entrepreneurship (technology se karobar), innovation (jiddat, naya pan) aur un skills ka taaruf bhi karata hai jo business ke mauqe pehchanne aur technology se asal zindagi ke masle hal karne ke liye zaroori hain. Talaba computing ke ethical (akhlaqi), legal (qanooni), social aur environmental (mahol se mutaliq) pehlu bhi dekhenge, jaise intellectual property (zehni takhleeq ki milkiyat), data privacy, cybersecurity ke qawaneen aur sustainable computing (mahol ko kam nuqsan dene wali computing). Woh zaati, taleemi aur professional zindagi mein teamwork, accessibility (sab ke liye rasai), digital communication aur technology ke zimmedarana istemal ki ahmiyat bhi seekhenge (Figure 9.1 dekhein). Aakhir tak talaba samajh jayenge ke rozmarra zindagi aur aane wale career mein technology ko mehfooz, zimmedarana, akhlaqi, mo-assar aur takhleeqi (creative) tareeqe se kaise istemal karna hai.

blocks.alt: Beech mein laptop, jis se chaar teer chaar nishanon ki taraf jate hain: dhaal (shield) par Security (upar baen), taala (padlock) par Privacy (upar daen), teen logon ka group Ethics & Teamwork (neeche baen) aur globe Global Connectivity (neeche daen).
blocks.caption: Figure 9.1: Aaj ki jure hue duniya mein cybersecurity, akhlaqiyat (ethics) aur digital ishtirak (collaboration) (kitab ki Figure 9.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure 9.1 ke beech mein laptop hai aur us se chaar teer nikalte hain: Security (dhaal), Privacy (taala), Ethics & Teamwork (logon ka group) aur Global Connectivity (globe). Matlab: aaj computer use karte waqt yeh chaaron baatein saath saath chalti hain, aur yahi is chapter ke bare hisse hain.

blocks.title: Cybersecurity
blocks.text: Cybersecurity computers, networks, data aur online accounts ko unauthorized access (be-ijazat rasai), ghalat istemal, nuqsan ya cyberattacks (online hamlon) se bachane ka amal hai. (Yeh tareef chapter ke Summary se hai.)

blocks.prompt: Teen cheezein batayein jo yeh chapter aap ko online mehfooz tareeqe se karna sikhayega.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: mazboot passwords aur two-factor authentication se accounts bachana; phishing jaise khatre pehchanna; Google Workspace jaise platforms par mehfooz ishtirak; aur technology ka qanooni aur akhlaqi istemal (koi teen).

items: Chapter: online safety, cybersecurity, data protection aur mehfooz collaboration.
Digital entrepreneurship aur innovation; computing ke ethical, legal aur environmental pehlu.
Teamwork, accessibility aur technology ka zimmedarana istemal.
